notes: Comprehensive collection of 100 Texas animal welfare organizations including municipal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, breed-specific rescues, wildlife rehabilitation centers, horse rescues, farm sanctuaries, TNR programs, and spay/neuter clinics. Texas has one of the largest shelter systems in the US. Coverage spans Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Fort Worth, El Paso, Corpus Christi, and surrounding areas.
